dct_title_s: Discoveries in Western Australia from documents furnished to the Colonial Office by I.S. Roe, Esqr. Survr. Genl
dct_description_sm: Includes upper right margin: Statistical report on Western Australia, 1837.
Publisher's no. from its catalog of nineteenth century maps of Australia from the British Parliamentary papers: 69.

Original version: London : J. Arrowsmith, 1838. Ordered by the House of Commons to be printed 1838.
